text_en: Let all who are under the yoke of slavery regard their masters as worthy of all honor, so that the name of God and the teaching may not be blasphemed.
text_cn: 凡负轭（è）为奴隶的，应认为自己的主人堪受各种尊敬，以免天主的名号和道理被人亵渎。

text_en: Those who have believing masters must not be disrespectful to them on the ground that they are members of the church; rather they must serve them all the more, since those who benefit by their service are believers and beloved. Teach and urge these duties.
text_cn: 奴隶若是有信教的主人，也不可因他们是弟兄，便加以轻视，反要越发服事他们，因为得服事之惠的是信徒，是可爱的弟兄。你要拿这些事教训人，劝勉人。

text_en: Whoever teaches otherwise and does not agree with the sound words of our Lord Jesus Christ and the teaching that is in accordance with godliness,
text_cn: 若有人讲异端道理，不顺从我们的主耶稣基督的健全道理，与那合乎虔敬的教训，

text_en: is conceited, understanding nothing, and has a morbid craving for controversy and for disputes about words. From these come envy, dissension, slander, base suspicions,
text_cn: 他必是妄自尊大，一无所知，患有辩论和舌战之癖的人；由此而生出嫉妒、争吵、谩骂、恶意的猜疑，

text_en: and wrangling among those who are depraved in mind and bereft of the truth, imagining that godliness is a means of gain.
text_cn: 以及心思败坏和丧失真理者的口角；他们以为虔敬是获利之源。

text_en: Of course, there is great gain in godliness combined with contentment;
text_cn: 的确，虔敬是一个获利的富源，但应有知足的心，

text_en: for we brought nothing into the world, so that we can take nothing out of it;
text_cn: 因为我们没有带什么到世界上，同样也不能带走什么，

text_en: but if we have food and clothing, we will be content with these.
text_cn: 只要我们有吃有穿，就当知足。

text_en: But those who want to be rich fall into temptation and are trapped by many senseless and harmful desires that plunge people into ruin and destruction.
text_cn: 至于那些想望致富的人，却陷于诱惑，堕入罗网和许多背理有害的欲望中，这欲望叫人沉溺于败坏和灭亡中，

text_en: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil, and in their eagerness to be rich some have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many pains.
text_cn: 因为贪爱钱财乃万恶的根源；有些人曾因贪求钱财而离弃了信德，使自己受了许多刺心的痛苦。

text_en: But as for you, man of God, shun all this; pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, endurance, gentleness.
text_cn: 至于你，天主的人哪！你要躲避这些事；但要追求正义、虔敬、信德、爱德、坚忍和良善，

text_en: Fight the good fight of the faith; take hold of the eternal life, to which you were called and for which you made the good confession in the presence of many witnesses.
text_cn: 要奋力打这场有关信仰的好仗，要争取永生：你正是为此而蒙召，并为此在许多证人前宣示了你那美好的誓言。

text_en: In the presence of God, who gives life to all things, and of Christ Jesus, who in his testimony before Pontius Pilate made the good confession, I charge you
text_cn: 我在使万有生活的天主前和曾对般雀比拉多宣过美好誓言的基督耶稣前命令你，

text_en: to keep the commandment without spot or blame until the manifestation of our Lord Jesus Christ,
text_cn: 务要保守这训令，不受玷污，无可指摘，直到我们的主耶稣基督的显现：

text_en: which he will bring about at the right time—he who is the blessed and only Sovereign, the King of kings and Lord of lords.
text_cn: 在预定的时期使人看见这显现的，是那真福，惟一全能者，万王之王，万主之主，

text_en: It is he alone who has immortality and dwells in unapproachable light, whom no one has ever seen or can see; to him be honor and eternal dominion. Amen.
text_cn: 是那独享不死不灭，住于不可接近的光中，没有人看见过，也不能看见的天主。愿尊崇和永远的威权归于他！阿们。

text_en: As for those who in the present age are rich, command them not to be haughty, or to set their hopes on the uncertainty of riches, but rather on God who richly provides us with everything for our enjoyment.
text_cn: 至于今世的富人，你要劝告他们，不要心高气傲，也不要寄望于无常的财富，惟独寄望于那将万物丰富地供给我们享用的天主。

text_en: They are to do good, to be rich in good works, generous, and ready to share,
text_cn: 又要劝他们行善，在善工上致富，甘心施舍，乐意通财，

text_en: thus storing up for themselves the treasure of a good foundation for the future, so that they may take hold of the life that really is life.
text_cn: 为自己积蓄良好的根基，以备将来能享受那真正的生命。

text_en: Timothy, guard what has been entrusted to you. Avoid the profane chatter and contradictions of what is falsely called knowledge;
text_cn: 弟茂德啊！要保管所受的寄托，要躲避凡俗的空谈，和假冒知识之名的反论。

text_en: by professing it some have missed the mark as regards the faith. Grace be with you.
text_cn: 有些人自充有这知识，但终于失落了信德。 愿恩宠与你们同在！
